title: Mirror functor for deformed preprojective algebras
summary: We study localized homological mirror symmetry associated to an immersed Lagrangian brane $\mathbb{L}$, possibly equipped with a higher rank flat bundle, of a symplectic manifold $X$. Under a certain finiteness assumption on the Floer theory of $\mathbb{L}$, we deduce a quasi-equivalence $\mathcal{D}\mathrm{Fuk}_\mathbb{L}(X) \cong \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{fd}}(\tilde{\mathcal A}_\mathbb{L})$ using Koszul duality, where $\tilde{\mathcal{A}}_{\mathbb{L}}$ is the dual differential graded quiver algebra called the extended localized mirror.
